items.question: What cognitive attainment results from knowing that hidden true nature?
premises: A hidden true nature exists as an object of knowledge.
Knowing that hidden true nature is a possible cognitive act.
All-knowingness can arise as a resulting state.
items.inference: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
uncertainties: The precise referent of taṃ depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
